paragraphs: R' Ḥanina ben Torta. See the entry R' Ḥanina Toratya.[^1]

notes.text: The heading has בן תורתא, ben Torta; the target has תורתייא, Toratya, without ben. The forms and their conventional vowels remain distinct. ערך supplies the cross-reference instruction, and both abbreviated titles remain R'.
